question: What is the average fastest lap time in seconds for Lewis Hamilton in all the Formula_1 races?
evidence: average fastest lap time = avg(fastestLapTime); The time is recorded on 'MM:SS.mmm'
clarification: Also keep rows that have no matching results record.
gold: SELECT AVG(CAST(SUBSTRING(T2.fastestLapTime, 1, INSTR(T2.fastestLapTime, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60 + CAST(SUBSTRING(T2.fastestLapTime, INSTR(T2.fastestLapTime, ':') + 1) AS REAL)) FROM drivers AS T1 LEFT JOIN results AS T2 ON T1.driverId = T2.driverId WHERE T1.surname = 'Hamilton' AND T1.forename = 'Lewis'
gold0: SELECT AVG(CAST(SUBSTR(T2.fastestLapTime, 1, INSTR(T2.fastestLapTime, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60 + CAST(SUBSTR(T2.fastestLapTime, INSTR(T2.fastestLapTime, ':') + 1) AS REAL)) FROM drivers AS T1 INNER JOIN results AS T2 ON T1.driverId = T2.driverId WHERE T1.surname = 'Hamilton' AND T1.forename = 'Lewis'

b.request: Average fastest lap time in seconds (converting 'MM:SS.mmm' to seconds) across all races for the driver Lewis Hamilton, starting from the drivers table and keeping Hamilton's row even when he has no matching results record (left join, so races without a results entry or fastest lap time are still included)
b.sql: SELECT AVG(CAST(substr(r.fastestLapTime, 1, instr(r.fastestLapTime, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60 + CAST(substr(r.fastestLapTime, instr(r.fastestLapTime, ':') + 1) AS REAL)) AS avg_fastest_lap_seconds FROM drivers d LEFT JOIN results r ON d.driverId = r.driverId AND r.fastestLapTime IS NOT NULL WHERE d.forename = 'Lewis' AND d.surname = 'Hamilton'

c.request:
What is the average fastest lap time in seconds for Lewis Hamilton in all the Formula_1 races?
Evidence: average fastest lap time = avg(fastestLapTime); The time is recorded on 'MM:SS.mmm'
Also keep rows that have no matching results record.
c.sql: SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN r.fastestLapTime IS NOT NULL AND instr(r.fastestLapTime, ':') > 0 THEN CAST(substr(r.fastestLapTime, 1, instr(r.fastestLapTime, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60 + CAST(substr(r.fastestLapTime, instr(r.fastestLapTime, ':') + 1) AS REAL) END) AS avg_fastest_lap_seconds FROM drivers d LEFT JOIN results r ON r.driverId = d.driverId WHERE d.forename = 'Lewis' AND d.surname = 'Hamilton'

d.request: What is the average fastest lap time in seconds for Lewis Hamilton across all Formula 1 races, keeping every Hamilton race row even if it has no matching record in the results table? (Average fastest lap time = avg(fastestLapTime), where the time is recorded in 'MM:SS.mmm' format.)
d.sql: SELECT AVG(CAST(substr(r.fastestLapTime, 1, instr(r.fastestLapTime, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60 + CAST(substr(r.fastestLapTime, instr(r.fastestLapTime, ':') + 1) AS REAL)) AS avg_fastest_lap_seconds FROM drivers d LEFT JOIN results r ON r.driverId = d.driverId WHERE d.forename = 'Lewis' AND d.surname = 'Hamilton'
